correction_note: Op. 22 (G 183-188), the Paris edition issued as 'libro quinto di quartetti ... opera XXVI'. This is the Le Duc issue -- RISM source 990005875, which records an E-Mn copy at Mp/2392|9, very likely this one. RISM 990005874 is the earlier La Chevardiere issue of the same edition, confirming the publisher succession La Chevardiere -> Le Duc (-> Imbault). 'Opera XXVI' is the publisher's number; Op. 22 is Gerard's.
